description: Activate a stable subscription ULID and generation. Start at 1; after confirmed deactivation use the next generation and a new key. Optional receiver headers are read from an absolute owner-private JSON file with headers_file; never put their values in tool arguments. The signing secret is saved in a new private output file and never returned to chat. Repeat the identical request and key with a new output file after uncertainty. Requires confirmed: true.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_webhook_subscription_activate
